answer: Each agent identity ties into a beacon vesting schedule: rewards earned per epoch drip out slowly, say 1/100th per epoch. A coordination thread runs continuously, clustering fake identities and forfeiting their unvested balances when flagged. To forge thousands of sybils, an attacker must pre-fund every identity, wait months to withdraw anything, and risk total forfeiture of most earnings, making flash-farming uneconomical while honest long-lived agents keep full payouts.
